description: This file contains utility functions for encoding, decoding, and constructing messages used in WebRTC communication, specifically related to 'rootcanal' message handling.

methods.name: rootCanalCalculateMessageSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a message based on its name and arguments.

methods.name: rootCanalAddU8
methods.description: Adds an 8-bit unsigned integer to a byte array at a specified position.

methods.name: rootCanalAddPayload
methods.description: Inserts a payload (byte array) into a larger byte array at a specified position.

methods.name: rootCanalAddString
methods.description: Encodes a string as UTF-8 and adds it to a byte array, prefixing with its length.

methods.name: createRootcanalMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message array from a command and arguments, ready for transmission.

methods.name: decodeRootcanalMessage
methods.description: Decodes a received message array back into a string message.
